infoLinks.urlText: Major Event Buses will run for the Bledisloe Cup
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 17 October 
  • Sydney Olympic Park Major Event Buses will run for the Bledisloe Cup at Accor Stadium.
  • Travel on Major Event Buses is included in the cost of your event ticket. Attendees do not need to tap on and off, simply show your match ticket to the driver when boarding buses.
  • Buses run frequently before and after the game. Service frequencies are subject to traffic conditions. Visit the Bledisloe Cup event page for more details.
